notes.title: Wunderling DX is out now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, inhabitants of The Vegetable Kingdom! Wunderling DX is OUT NOW!

This deluxe edition is the ultimate and final version of critically acclaimed Wunderling, and guess what? It's free for everyone who's already purchased the game!

Wunderling DX features new items to unlock, levels to explore, a speedrunner timer, and previously released content update ""Kohlrabi's Ruin"". The game is packed with exciting content for new as well as seasoned gamers.

Happy gaming from all of us at Bitwave Games (formerly Retroid)!

[previewyoutube=x9Riu4dvE_w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Wunderling DX is launching on March 8th!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce [b]Wunderling DX[/b] - the ultimate and final version of our critically acclaimed non-stop puzzle platformer!

This deluxe edition features tons of content including new challenging levels, quirky items to collect, story segments, a brand new speedrun timer, and previously released content update "Kohlrabi's Ruin".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220298/329454b3539b836e72971b6914ee46a001cdd717.png[/img]

Wunderling DX tells a touching tale of breaking free from the pack with a desire to change the world, even with the odds stacked against you. What starts as a retro game love song soon becomes an unexpected thrill-ride with twists, turns, and alternate endings. All wrapped up in a humorous script from the wild mind of Alex Faciane, accompanied by Ratvader's decade-bending soundtrack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220298/26593431cccf1bedaa62bfcc7db254184e06acdf.png[/img]

Wunderling DX releases on Steam on March 8th, 2022. The update is free for everyone who's already purchased the game.

notes.title: GREAT SPROUT! The free content update releases NOW!
notes.notes:
After a hot pursuit through perilous deserts, savage jungles, and hazardous factories, our lemon-like hero lunges towards adventure's end.

Will the unearthing of Kohlrabi's diabolical schemes shake the Vegetable Kingdom in its very foundation? What fate awaits our wandering Wunderling? Who can you trust when it all comes falling down?

Join us for the STUNNING, TRUE CONCLUSION of the saga!

INTRODUCING:
* A whole new world with 15 challenging levels and 3 hidden levels!
* New fabulous items, bringing the total number of costume pieces to 127!
* Polish, fixes, and an overhauled UI!
* A laser-crazed and zestful BOSS FIGHT!

The new world with all its challenges is available after world 6, while the breathtaking conclusion to the story reveals itself after you have collected all of Princess Pea's diary pages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220298/fb1e242dbe5814e35c04947b23098c8b50011474.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Do you want to playtest new Wunderling content?
notes.notes:
[h1]We are looking for playtesters for Wunderling![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36220298/a2a0cf38d247aad8e66ae6cdc2b4512266bb6218.png[/img]

[h3]As we have stated many times before, your opinion matters to us. That is why we are now reaching out to the fans and asking you to help us![/h3]

New things are happening in the world of Wunderling and these new things need to be tested. We are looking for playtesters to try the new content, report bugs and have an opinion on just about everything! You would be in close contact with the dev team and help us make the game the best it could be. 
Your name would also be in the credits for Wunderling!
If this sounds interesting to you, please fill in the form below!

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*] You must own a copy of Wunderling on steam, where the test will take place.
[*] You must provide proof of having finished the game. Either by making your Steam profile public to show your achievements or by image if you've completed it on another platform such as Xbox One, Playstation 4 or Nintendo Switch. 
[*] Fluent in English or Swedish. 
[*] Communication will be through Discord or Email. 
[/list]

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1HivSEhITgtm2mlooexsnJ9QjmM2Ca1gKk6_faKpoF6K6qg/viewform?usp=sf_link][b][u][Click here to fill in form!][/u][/b][/url]
For further questions feel free to email us at info@retroid.com

notes.title: Version 1.2 is released on Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Wunderlings!

Version 1.2 is finally also out on Nintendo Switch! Here are the patch notes:

[h1]Item Randomization[/h1]
You can now randomize your equipped items through the [b]Collections[/b] menu!
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/SWp5pmeAIVDOXL6YzE/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed 5-3 “floating trampoline“ bug
[*]Dash the Cow now has some more things to say before rewarding you with a diary page
[*]Dash the Cow will now clearly tell you how many chests you need to pass
[*]Minor dialogue tweaks and fixes
[*]Various minor level tweaks and visual clarity improvements
[*]Rebalanced the audio levels of some outlying audio effects
[*]Changed the item Eyeglasses to Eyeglass
[/list]

Stay safe and have a great day!

notes.title: Achievement fix
notes.notes:
Some of the achievements such as Walkabout Wipeout and Rockrose Riot didn't trigger correctly. They got unlocked by just completing the level or not being unlocked at all!

Now they are triggered correctly after beating the level 100% and moving past the "level finished" screen. Apologies for everyone who had this issue, just replaying the level should be enough if you already got everything.

notes.title: Wunderling Item Suggestions
notes.notes:
Fellow Wunderlings, we need your help!

We will release more levels soon and more levels means more treasures, meaning, more items! We've seen lots of love for the crazy costume combinations on Twitter.

But what if you wanted that final piece, like a unicorn horn, goatee or a cheese hat? Your dreams can finally come true!

We want your help to come up with more costume ideas for some of the content to come, just add what you want to see in the game and we might add it! We're going to pick the best ideas that are actually doable in pixelart.

If your item gets picked we will add your name to the item in the game, isn't that cool!?

All you have to do is fill in the form below and we'll announce the items on Twitter, so make sure to follow [url=https://twitter.com/retroidofficial]@RetroidOfficial[/url] to see when we announce the new items.

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdRl5Ynl-IITUrG-XgUtjCxxTjGTvIzqYc_Y0BDR_IV2ktI0A/viewform][h2]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdRl5Ynl-IITUrG-XgUtjCxxTjGTvIzqYc_Y0BDR_IV2ktI0A/viewform[/h2][/url]


Have fun and stay safe!

notes.title: Version 1.1 is released!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Wunderlings!

We hope that everyone is all right in times like these, stay safe!

We have gone live with version 1.1 of Wunderling and here is the patch notes:

[b]Boss 1 (Wunderdragon)[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed charge attack mechanic from mashing to hold
[*]Fixed possible softlock issue
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*]Stability improvements
[*]Fixed an issue where custom button mappings would not be correctly loaded at game start
[*]Reduced performance impact of certain animals
[*]Spikeballs blink slightly less often
[*]Fixed being unable to jump out of portal after respawning on certain levels
[*]Minor level improvements and visual clarity tweaks
[*]The Wunderling menu cursor is no longer hidden when navigating menus using the mouse
[*]The Steam notification now appears in the top-right corner
[*]Where possible, the game is now automatically paused if a controller is disconnected or the Steam overlay is opened
[/list]

Have a great day!
